initialize_torchcomms_backend: initialize a PyTorchTorchcommsBackend with ncclx backend for distributed training across GPU ranks
run_all_reduce_collective: run an all_reduce collective operation on a tensor using the torchcomms communicator with sum or avg op
create_process_groups: create split process groups from the world communicator using torchcomms split for subgroup communication
run_all_to_all_collective: run an all_to_all or all_to_allv collective operation to exchange tensor chunks across all ranks
run_broadcast_collective: run a broadcast collective to send a tensor from a root rank to all other ranks in the group
